title: Patient Financial Assistance Program: Extending the Documents Due Date at the Applicant's Request
content:
**Extension.** Under the Patient Financial Assistance Program, at the applicant's own request the documents due date may be extended, no more often than the maximum number of extensions per case allows. The result this policy governs is the number of calendar days by which the documents due date moves forward.

The extended due date is not fixed until the case carries a documents-requested date and a documents due date.

Put the other way: while the case carries no documents-requested date, or no documents due date, the extended due date is not fixed.

## The extension request

`request_document_extension_ca0bff0a` is the applicant's own request, on their own behalf, for an extension of the documents due date on their pending financial-assistance application. One call moves the case's documents due date forward by the given number of calendar days and adds one to the extensions granted on the case; nothing else is checked or changed. On success the applicant sees the new documents due date on the case.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `request_document_extension_ca0bff0a` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `assistance_case_id` | The reference number of the applicant's assistance case, as given to the applicant by the agent from the assistance-case lookup | Reference number |
| `extension_days` | The number of calendar days the documents due date moves forward, as given to the applicant by the agent | A positive whole number |

### Return

On success the request returns a text rendering of a record with `status` "extension_recorded", `assistance_case_id` (echoed), `documents_due_date` (the new due date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `extension_count` (the extensions granted on the case after this one, a whole number).

**Illustration (hypothetical request).** On a case whose documents due date is 12 October 2026 and which has had no extension, an `extension_days` value of 15 returns a documents due date of 27 October 2026 and an `extension_count` of 1.
